{"metadata":{"description":"Chat with, monitor, and approve your DSH agents from WeChat — an iLink gateway + conversation node bundle for DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1333338499","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-chatnode-wechat","slug":"Jesse-njx/dsh-chatnode-wechat","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","ilink","wechat","weixin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Chat with, monitor, and approve your DSH agents from WeChat — an iLink gateway + conversation node b"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"undle for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-chatnode-wechat"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Chat with, monitor, and approve your DSH agents from WeChat.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness bundle
that connects a DSH profile to a WeChat personal account over Tencent's
un"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"official **iLink bot gateway** (`ilinkai.weixin.qq.com`) — the same
mechanism hermes-agent and OpenC"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"law use. Text and images go both ways
(inbound images are downloaded, decrypted and handed to the ag"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ent; `/send`
sends an image back), session targeting works with
`/sessions /use /new /stop /status`,"},{"id":"p4s5","text":" permission requests are answered with
`/yes` / `/no` right in the chat, and progress is reported as"},{"id":"p4s6","text":" digest-style
messages instead of a tool-call firehose."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The bundle ships **two separable Cordis plugins**:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Plugin | Role |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| `wechat-gateway` (`WechatGateway`) | iLink service (`ctx.wechat`): QR login, authenticated long-po"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ll, reconnect/backoff, send retry + rate-limit circuit, typing indicator, encrypted CDN media downlo"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ad/upload (`downloadImage` / `sendImage`). |
| `wechat-conversation-node` | WeChat ⇄ DSH bridge: all"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"owlist gate, session targeting, commands, digest outbound (chunked + throttled), approvals. |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## ⚠️ Read this first"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **One poller per account.** iLink allows exactly ONE authenticated poller
per bot token. If you al"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"so run **hermes-agent** or **OpenClaw** on the same
WeChat account, one of them gets HTTP 403s and d"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"rops messages. Use a
**dedicated WeChat account** for the agent, and never run two instances of
this"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" bundle against the same token.
- **Unofficial gateway.** This rides the same unofficial mechanism a"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"s
hermes/openclaw; Tencent could restrict the account. Again: use a dedicated
account you are willin"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"g to lose.
- **Unofficial protocol.** iLink details are reconstructed from hermes-agent
source, not "},{"id":"p10s7","text":"Tencent docs. Recorded transcripts live in
`test/fixtures/inbound.ndjson` so CI never needs a live a"},{"id":"p10s8","text":" docs. Recorded transcripts live in
`test/fixtures/inbound.ndjson` so CI never needs a live account."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Credentials are stored through the **dsh credentials service** — never in the
patch file. Pair your "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"WeChat account once:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"This writes `WEIXIN_ACCOUNT_ID` / `WEIXIN_BOT_TOKEN` / `WEIXIN_BASE_URL` to
`$DSH_HOME/.credentials."},{"id":"p15s2","text":"yaml` (via `dsh-credentials-local`). The bundle
resolves them at boot and starts polling automatical"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"l` (via `dsh-credentials-local`). The bundle
resolves them at boot and starts polling automatically."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`allowFrom` is **mandatory with no permissive default**: an agent that accepts
instructions from any"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" WeChat contact is a prompt-injection front door.
Messages from non-allowlisted senders are logged a"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"nd ignored — they are never
fed to the model."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Send text or images to the bot. Everything is zero-config once one session
exists — the **most recen"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"t session** is the default target."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Images"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Inbound**: send an image to the bot; the gateway downloads and decrypts it
(encrypted CDN + AES-"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"128-ECB), persists it under `mediaDir` (default
`$DSH_HOME/attachments/wechat/`), and hands the file"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" path to the agent,
which decodes it with its `read_image`/vision tool.
- **Outbound**: `/send <abso"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"lute-path>` sends a local image back to the
current contact (AES-encrypt → `getuploadurl` → CDN uplo"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"ad →
`sendmessage`). Sending depends on the peer's `context_token`, so it runs
inside the gateway pr"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"sendmessage`). Sending depends on the peer's `context_token`, so it runs
inside the gateway process."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Command | What it does |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| *(plain text)* | routes to the active agent (`agent.followup`) |
| *(image)* | downloaded, decrypt"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ed, saved, path handed to the agent |
| `/sessions` | numbered session list (most recent first) |
| "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"`/use N` | switch the active session |
| `/new <prompt>` | create a fresh agent+session and start |
"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"| `/stop` | cancel the active turn |
| `/status` | agent status + session summary |
| `/send <path>`"},{"id":"p24s5","text":" | send a local image to the current contact |
| `/yes` `/no` (or `1`/`2` while one request is pendi"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"ng) | answer a permission request |
| `/help` | command list |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Outbound is digest-style, never a mirror of every tool call:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- `⏳ 收到，开始处理…` when a turn starts,
- a one-line `🔄 仍在处理中…` heartbeat every `digestIntervalSec`,
- th"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"e assistant's actual text (chunked to `maxMessageChars`, throttled),
- `❌ 出错…` / `⏹ 已停止` / `⚠️ 输出截断`"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" on turn end,
- `🔐 #N 需要你的确认` permission prompts, answered in-chat."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Approvals"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"WeChat personal accounts have no buttons. When a DSH permission request
fires, the bridge renders it"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" as a numbered text prompt and waits:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"`/yes` (or `1` while exactly one request is pending) grants `allowed-once`;
`/no` (`2`) rejects; a t"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"imeout falls back to DSH's default **deny**. The
bridge only answers requests for the agent currentl"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"y driven by the WeChat
user — anything else is delegated down the answerer chain."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- `test/fake-ilink-server.ts` implements the iLink endpoints (getupdates
long-poll, sendmessage, sen"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"dtyping, getconfig, QR login, encrypted CDN) and
replays `test/fixtures/inbound.ndjson`; the full
in"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"bound→session→outbound loop runs in CI.
- `pnpm smoke` is the manual live-account script (set `WEIXI"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"N_ALLOW_FROM`).
- Pin the dsh-base family (`@deepseek-ai/*` at `0.1.0-rc.6` in this repo) —
DSH is a"},{"id":"p33s5","text":" developer preview and upstream breaks are expected."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Risks"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| Risk | Mitigation |"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"| **iLink exclusive lock** — two pollers on one token → 403 + dropped messages | Dedicated account; "},{"id":"p36s2","text":"loud fatal error + polling stop on 403; documented coexistence warning |
| **Account restriction** —"},{"id":"p36s3","text":" unofficial gateway | Dedicated account; stated plainly in this README |
| **DSH v0.1 churn** | Pinn"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"ed `@deepseek-ai/*` deps; CI against the pinned versions |
